title: Bridging Rollout Runway and Health Index
content:
Purpose:
This working doc defines a compact, cross-functional Rollout Runway + Health Index that product-ops, eng, SRE, and GTM can use to make go/no-go decisions and to track live health during phased launches. It combines a timeline, owner map, primary KPIs (latency/cost/quality/adoption), and an incident-ready decision ladder for fast mitigation.

Scope:
- Applies to feature and product launches that impact model serving (hosted, dedicated, private).
- Focused on first 6 weeks post alpha (pre-Beta + Beta + GA ramp).
- Not a replacement for detailed runbooks; links to SRE and security runbooks are included below.

High-level goals:
1) Reduce decision latency by surfacing an indexed health score (0-100) updated daily.
2) Standardize gating thresholds across infra-sensitive launches (latency, error-rate, model-regression).
3) Provide a short contingency playbook that non-SRE product managers can run.

Launch phases (owner / goals / key dates):
- Alpha (internal tests) — Owner: Diego Morales — Dates: 2026-02-22 to 2026-03-05 — Goal: exercise flow, measure baseline latency/cost, collect early quality signals.
- Closed Beta (pilot customers) — Owner: Katherine Yu — Dates: 2026-03-08 to 2026-03-22 — Goal: validate cost model, track adoption metrics, soft-load tests.
- Open Beta (wider opt-in) — Owner: Priya Singh — Dates: 2026-03-23 to 2026-04-12 — Goal: measure 95p latency under production shapes, surfaced regressions, and UX metrics.
- GA Ramp — Owner: Asha Patel — Dates: 2026-04-13 to 2026-05-13 — Goal: scale to committed capacity and full telemetry.

Runway health index (computation notes):
- Composite of four pillars: Latency (30%), Errors/Reliability (30%), Model Quality (20%), Adoption/Business Signals (20%).
- Each pillar scored 0-100 based on rolling-24h window against thresholds. Pillar weights multiply and sum to a 0-100 health index.
- Quick thresholds (draft):
  - Latency: target p95 <= 300ms (score 100). 300-600ms linear degrade to 0.
  - Errors: 5xx + model-timeouts <= 0.5% (score 100). 0.5%-2% degrade to 0.
  - Model Quality: eval-suite baseline (synthetic prompts) delta <= 1.5% quality drop (score 100). 1.5%-5% degrade to 0.
  - Adoption: feature usage growth meets expected cohort (score mapped to adoption ramp curve). If adoption is flat/negative, index reduces.

Primary KPIs to monitor (daily and per-route):
- p95 latency (ms) — owner: infra/serving
- Request success rate (>= 99.5%) — owner: SRE
- Token cost per 1k tokens (USD) — owner: finance/product-ops
- Regression rate vs baseline eval (pct prompts failing threshold) — owner: applied-ml
- Activation conversion (trial -> retained user) — owner: growth
- Time to first meaningful response (for streaming features) — owner: product

Health index bands and recommended actions:
- 85-100 (green): proceed. Continue normal ramp. Daily sync remains once per week.
- 65-84 (yellow): throttle ramp by 50% for one day; open dedicated Slack incident channel; disable non-essential background jobs; increase tracing sample.
- 40-64 (orange): halt new invites; enable read-only fallback model variant (lower-cost / simpler); exec-level alert and twice-daily product-ops/SRE standup until resolved.
- <40 (red): immediate rollback or enforce traffic split to stable model region; escalate to on-call and product leadership; enable customer-facing mitigation messaging.

Preflight checklist (must be green before Beta):
- [ ] Canary infra verified under 2x expected alpha peak (SRE sign-off, runbook link: PROD-SRE-Canary-2026).
- [ ] Baseline evaluation harness run (applied-ml) and documented deltas.
- [ ] Cost per 1k tokens forecasted and finance sign-off on burst tolerance.
- [ ] Alerting thresholds configured in Console (p95, error-rate, token-cost).
- [ ] Support playbook drafted and owned by CS (customer templates + escalation matrix).
- [ ] Legal/security checklist: data residency validated for pilot customers.

Day-of-launch quick ops actions:
- Start-of-day: snapshot baseline telemetry (p50/p95/error). Save to /prodops/launch-snapshots/ with tag.
- Hourly for first 12h: health index log + slack summary in #launch-health.
- Any pillar drop >10 points: trigger Yellow play.

Contingency playbook (short-form):
1) Identify failing pillar via console -> route -> last-24h.
2) If latency spike: check tail KV-cache metrics, bump batching/gpu-allocation (infra). Fall back to smaller model if autoscaling lagging.
3) If error spike: correlate with deployment window, rollback last deployment, or isolate region.
4) If quality regression: enable previous model version (model pin), notify customers, create rollback PR.
5) If cost runaway: enable rate limits, switch routing to cheaper region, or toggle quantization profile for affected model type.

Ownership matrix (short):
- Product-ops (Asha) — health index ownership, GTM coordination, stakeholder comms.
- Serving runtime (Diego) — infrastructure, latency mitigations, autoscaler tuning.
- Applied ML (Omar) — model evals, regression detection, model-pin actions.
- SRE (Katherine) — canary testing, incident response, runbook authoring.
- Customer Success (Priya) — customer comms templates, ticket triage.

Risk register (top 5):
- R1: Unexpected model regression at scale — Mitigation: staged mirroring in Beta + automated eval hooks (owner: applied-ml).
- R2: p95 latency regresses due to KV-cache invalidation — Mitigation: conservative cache TTLs, warmup traffic (owner: serving runtime).
- R3: Cost per token exceeds forecast during GA — Mitigation: pre-approved budget, circuit breaker for per-project spend (owner: finance/product-ops).
- R4: Regulatory/data residency flags from pilot customers — Mitigation: blocklist regions, legal sign-off (owner: security/compliance).
- R5: Observability blind spots — Mitigation: daily tracing sanity checks and synthetic alert tests (owner: observability).

Short-term metrics dashboard (required panels):
- Health index timeline (daily) with pillar breakdown.
- Per-route p95 and error-rate heatmap.
- Model-eval drift scatter (per-eval-batch).
- Cost delta vs forecast (rolling 7d).
- Adoption cohort funnel (day0-day7 retention).

Communication plan:
- Internal: daily 09:00 PST standup for first 7 days of Beta; weekly exec summary on Fridays.
- External: pre-approved customer note templates for Yellow/Orange/Red states; CS to own outbound.

Open questions (for product-ops sync):
- Should the health index weight model-quality higher for feature launches that change output tone? (proposal: +10% weight, reduce adoption weight)
- Do we lock p95 threshold to absolute ms or relative to baseline (baseline helps for large model size differences)?
- Is there appetite for an automated rollback policy at 3am local that requires manual authorizations?

Next actions (this week):
- Finalize dashboard panels (Katherine) by 2026-02-20.
- Run 2x canary load test and attach results (Diego) by 2026-02-21.
- Draft customer-facing Yellow/Orange templates (Priya) by 2026-02-22.
- Lock cost circuit-breaker rules with finance (Asha + Omar) by 2026-02-23.

Notes to self / rough ideas:
- Consider a "soft-stop" flag that automatically halves new user invites on sustained 10-point drop for 48h.
- We may want a separate health index variant for Private deployments that weights security and residency higher.

Attachments / links: see linked_artifacts above. Also: PROD-SLA-2026.pdf (in security drive), SRE canary runbook (PROD-SRE-Canary-2026), Applied-ML eval harness: GH: redwood-inference/eval-harness#78.
